notes: Example values for a fixture or a first try only; this is not a recommended, reviewed, or validated policy.
Freeze your own views, weights, seed, cluster rule, and minimum cluster count before any result is read; choosing them after seeing results defeats the policy.

Declare workload_weights only when a summary across workloads is intended, and target_weights (with 'explicit' in views) only when every canonical target of a view is weighted and the weights sum to 1.
